name: Afflictions And Adversities
overview: Scripture reveals that afflictions and adversities are often consequences of the fall, as seen in God's pronouncement of sorrow and labor to the woman and cursed ground to Adam (Genesis 3:16-17). These hardships also manifest in the experiences of God's people, such as Abram's descendants being afflicted in a foreign land for a divinely appointed time before deliverance and blessing (Genesis 15:13-14). Even in distress, God’s providence is evident, exemplified by the angel of the LORD finding Hagar in the wilderness, showing divine care amid human suffering (Genesis 16:7-8). Thus, afflictions are not arbitrary but regulated by God’s sovereign hand and often serve a redemptive purpose within His plan.
